name: Intact Raptor Horn
summary: Across the Barrens savannas, raptors are hunted for their intact horns. Mebok Mizzyrix of Ratchet wants them for a scheme built on rumors of raptor intelligence.

sections.title: A Questionable Ingredient
sections.body: Hunters prize raptor hides, talons, and trophies, but whole horns are harder to take in the field. Mebok Mizzyrix, an eccentric goblin alchemist in Ratchet, believes the Barrens raptors are more cunning than their kin elsewhere. He suspects their intellect lies in their horns. By grinding whole horns and brewing them into tonics, Mebok hopes to bottle that supposed genius in commercial drinks.

sections.title: Stalking the Prides
sections.body: A horn fit for brewing must come from a particularly vicious predator, not just any young raptor. Sunscale Scytheclaws prowl the southern plains and the northern borders near Ashenvale. Takk the Leaper and the elusive Ishamuhale are notable terrors of the veldt, and their stout horns can survive the clash of the hunt intact.

faq.q: Who wants these intact raptor horns?
faq.answer: Mebok Mizzyrix, a goblin merchant and aspiring brewer in Ratchet, seeks intact horns. He believes they hold the key to his next get-rich-quick product.

faq.q: Why do the horns need to be intact?
faq.answer: Mebok plans to grind whole horns into a fine powder for ingestion. Hunters discard chipped or broken horns, or consider them spent, because they lack the full potency he hopes to harness for his recipes.
Mature Sunscale Scytheclaws carry them in the northern and southern extremes of the Barrens. Notorious unique raptors, including Ishamuhale and Takk the Leaper, bear them too.

faq.q: Do raptor horns actually make you smarter?
faq.answer: Barrens raptors show unusual pack cunning and coordination, but no one has proved their intelligence rests in their horns or can pass to someone through a drink.

angles.text: As a hunter, taking a trophy horn whole calls for a clean kill against some of the savannas' fiercest predators.
As a cook, you may hear Mebok plans to pulverize the horns for wine infusions. Practical survivalists favor raptor parts for toolcrafting over palatable cuisine.
